Chocolate Glaze
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 5:37pm

Ingredients




2 tablespoons cocoa
1 tablespoon corn syrup
1 tablespoon + 2 Tsp. water
1 tablespoon Crisco oil
1 cup confectioner's sugar, sift if lumpy

Preparation

1 In a small saucepan combine all ingredients except sugar. Cook and stir over low heat until mixture is smooth. 2 Remove from heat; beat in sugar. If mixture is too thick to pour easily, add a little more water. 3 Drizzle over cake.
